engine: A composed PORTRAIT 9:16 hero PLATE — the editorial vertical hero for mobile-first / portrait-render sites. ONE create() call builds, from data, a centred portrait plate: a 9:16 framed render (object-fit cover, the hero subject) inside a thin coords/meta frame, an eyebrow above, a serif title, and a small bottom meta row. On enter the whole plate SETTLES (scale 1.04 -> 1 + opacity 0 -> 1, power3.out) and the type STAGGERS in (eyebrow -> title -> meta), each rising opacity + translateY. The most 'section-like' of the portrait family but still a single reusable atom (one create(), data-driven).

measured_teardown.move: the atom builds its own DOM from data, then runs ONE composed reveal. (1) the plate SETTLES on enter: transform scale enterScale (1.04) -> 1 + opacity 0 -> 1, power3.out, finishing by ~0.6 of the timeline. (2) the type STAGGERS under it: eyebrow, title, meta each opacity 0 -> 1 + translateY ~22px -> 0, offset by revealStagger. DECODE-GUARD: img.decode() resolves BEFORE the plate is revealed (a hidden img doesn't decode -> revealing undecoded = black flicker). set(p 0..1) is a PURE reversible function of progress (settle + per-child eased windows); play() runs the timed reveal once; autoplay false + set(p) lets a host scrub it.
measured_teardown.cited: editorial vertical hero abstraction: a portrait 9:16 render in a thin frame, centred, with eyebrow + serif title + a small meta row beneath — the mobile-first / portrait-render hero plate. Adjacent to vertical-awards-rail and portrait-carousel but distinct (a single composed hero plate, not a rail or a deck).

media.what: path to the portrait render (object-fit cover fills the 9:16 frame). Force-decoded before reveal.

eyebrow.what: small uppercase overline above the title (brand / locality kicker).

title.what: the serif hero title (the one thought of the plate).

meta.what: string | string[] for the bottom meta row; items are joined with a dot separator.

ratio.what: aspect-ratio of the framed render. Portrait by design; '9/16' is the canonical vertical hero.

revealStagger.what: offset feel between staggered type children (eyebrow -> title -> meta); also lengthens the autoplay timeline.

enterScale.what: plate scale at the start of the settle (settles to 1). Subtle push-down, never a zoom-bomb.

autoplay.what: run the timed reveal once on init (after decode). false = idle at set(1) unless the host drives set(p).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present and none is global; false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: PortraitVerticalHero.create(target, opts) -> { el, plate, img, set(p), play(), destroy() }. target = an EMPTY mount element (the atom builds the plate DOM from data). set(p 0..1) is a PURE reversible function of the composed reveal; play() runs it once.
law: transform scale/translateY + opacity ONLY (NO animating width/height/top/left/margin); GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL / NO canvas. DECODE-GUARD: never reveal an undecoded . will-change cleared after the one-shot. reduced-motion or no-GSAP -> static composed plate (everything shown, no motion). owns_pin false (a self-contained plate; the host may pin it or not). GSAP optional for motion; set(p) standalone (pure, no GSAP needed).
gate_mode: open lab.html. __LAB_OK__ true once wired + the render painted (decode-guarded). Watch the enter: the portrait plate settles (scale 1.04 -> 1 + opacity) and the type staggers in (eyebrow -> title -> meta). Verify it reads award-grade as a STANDALONE plate, centred with generous air. set(0) hides, set(1) shows the full composed plate (pure scrub). reduced-motion -> static. Distinct from vertical-awards-rail (a list) and portrait-carousel (a deck) — this is ONE composed hero plate.

The render is decoded before reveal (no black flicker); the plate settles 1.04 -> 1 + opacity, the type staggers in. set(p) confirmed pure + reversible.
